name: reneo-webrtc-assessment
description: Reneo WebRTC / Live Streaming Internship Technical Assessment

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npx tsc -p ./tsconfig.json --noEmit && cd ../client && npx tsc -p ./tsconfig.json --noEmit
